PROJECT.NAME: Pridruživanje ulazne fakture dobavljača direktnoj primci u maloprodaji
PROJECT.CAPTION: Pridruživanje ulazne fakture dobavljača direktnoj primci u maloprodaji

FILTERFORM.NAME: FILTERFORM
FILTERFORM.CAPTION: Uvjeti prikaza
FILTERFORM.ONLOAD: select @@datumod as datumod, @@datumdo as datumdo, @@partneriid as partneriid, 1 as nepovezano, 0 as neproknj

INPUT.NAME: partneriid
INPUT.CAPTION: Partneri*
INPUT.SQL: select distinct p.partneriid,ltrim(rtrim(p.naziv)) as [Naziv] from partneri p with(nolock) inner join maloprodajagla g with(nolock) on p.partneriid=g.partneriid inner join vrstadok v with(nolock) on g.vrstadokid=v.vrstadokid inner join vrstaprom vp with(nolock) on v.vrstapromid=vp.vrstapromid where vp.sifra in ('99','305') order by naziv

MULTIBLUEPOVEZI_FORM.NAME: MULTIBLUEPOVEZI_FORM
MULTIBLUEPOVEZI_FORM.CAPTION: Izaberi fakturu
MULTIBLUEPOVEZI_FORM.ONLOADSTARO: select Napomena as napomena, nabiznos+iznospov as ukunabiznos, 1 as nepovezano from maloprodajagla where maloprodajaglaid=@@id
MULTIBLUEPOVEZI_FORM.ONLOAD: select sum(g.nabiznos+g.iznospov) as ukunabiznos, 1 as nepovezano from maloprodajagla g with(nolock) inner join totalgenmultiselecttemp t on g.maloprodajaglaid = t.id where t.operateriid = @@operateriid and susersname = suser_name()

MULTIBLUEPROKNJIZI.NAME: MULTIBLUEPROKNJIZI
MULTIBLUEPROKNJIZI.CAPTION: Knjiženje MP kalkulacija na temeljnice
